verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents the CUDA Toolkit and related SDKs (Nsight, RTX Neural Shaders) as a public, documented programming interface for the GPU, which is the closest analog to an 'API' for this hardware. However, probes show no OpenAPI/REST-style API or machine-readable docs endpoints (404s), and there's no evidence of an agent-friendly control interface—CUDA is a low-level compute API for developers, not an agentic control surface. Missing for 10: REST/OpenAPI or agent-callable API, evidence of AI-agent-oriented control/automation of the GPU rather than just GPU-accelerated compute programming.
